P01.stelling_en: I spend quite a lot of time checking all payroll processing tasks.
P01.oplossing_en: Automate payroll processing with our Payroll Workflows. See the status of every client in one overview, automate routine tasks and use the Run Check before each payroll run.

P02.stelling_en: I have no direct insight into possible errors before the payroll run.
P02.oplossing_en: With the Payroll Output Checker you compare periods effortlessly. It maps deviating percentages, changed components and differences instantly, so you can validate changes quickly and give them a status.

P03.stelling_en: I can't easily see how a change affects employer costs.
P03.oplossing_en: Use the Interactive Payslip to apply changes directly and see the employer costs without running a new payroll.

P04.stelling_en: Analysing differences between payroll periods is time-consuming.
P04.oplossing_en: With the Payroll Output Checker you compare periods effortlessly. It maps relevant information and deviations instantly, so you can validate changes quickly and give them a status.

P05.stelling_en: I often have to remind my clients to submit their hours and changes for the period.
P05.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs you can set up an automated workflow action that emails your clients before every payroll. It encourages them to submit changes directly in Nmbrs, or to let you know there are no changes this month.

P06.stelling_en: I can't see clearly which changes were made by which colleague.
P06.oplossing_en: The Input Checker shows quickly and easily which changes were made for which employee, and lets you give them a status. You can also filter on different components.

P07.stelling_en: I can't easily generate pro forma payslips.
P07.oplossing_en: The Pro forma Payslip gives quick insight into net pay and employer costs for new employees or employees who have not yet been entered.

P08.stelling_en: Downloading and sharing payroll files and paying salaries and payroll tax takes quite some time.
P08.oplossing_en: With Nmbrs Pay you prepare payments in your bank straight from Nmbrs, without downloading a single SEPA file by hand. You save time and reduce the risk of errors in the payment process.

P09.stelling_en: It is hard to determine the right pay for my employees.
P09.oplossing_en: Use Salary Numbee to compare salary data for similar roles in our database and get a framework for setting a fair salary.

P10.stelling_en: I am not kept informed about special arrangements with an employee.
P10.oplossing_en: Identify and solve problems before the payroll run with Runcheck Numbee, which proactively flags possible errors.

P11.stelling_en: I have no tool to apply consistent wage codes for new employees.
P11.oplossing_en: Keep wage codes consistent for new employees with Wage code Numbee, which suggests suitable codes automatically, for example for bonuses.

P12.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time processing the travel expenses of all employees.
P12.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs you can calculate travel allowances automatically by adding a travel component based on a Google Maps calculation.

P13.stelling_en: Keeping track of all vehicle changes for all employees is quite a job.
P13.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs, licence plate recognition retrieves vehicle information quickly so changes are processed faster.

P14.stelling_en: The system does not take individual or exceptional employee wishes into account.
P14.oplossing_en: Adjust thousands of pay and hour codes for specific cases, so you can meet the individual wishes and exceptions of companies.

P15.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time entering data from one system into another.
P15.oplossing_en: Use the Excel Import/Export function to enter large amounts of data efficiently and create reports without wasting valuable time. Plus 188 integrations with related applications.

P16.stelling_en: I can't calculate transition payments automatically.
P16.oplossing_en: Nmbrs calculates transition payments automatically and makes the process simple, processing it on one employee and one payslip.

P17.stelling_en: Making retroactive corrections for every employee is quite time-consuming.
P17.oplossing_en: Make corrections for one or all employees with the Retroactive Corrections feature, which is applied automatically in the journal entries.

P18.stelling_en: Managing multiple employments for the same employee is cumbersome.
P18.oplossing_en: Manage multiple employments for the same employee effortlessly, whatever the number of roles, with unlimited employments.

P19.stelling_en: I sometimes find that current legislation has not been implemented.
P19.oplossing_en: We implement legislation once it is final, relevant and worth the development and maintenance effort. We always weigh impact against priority to use our resources effectively. This approach has proven reliable and efficient for 15 years.

P20.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time managing collective agreement models.
P20.oplossing_en: Maintaining multiple collective agreements lets you set all sector data at once, which speeds up and refines the process.

P21.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time processing changes.
P21.oplossing_en: Let the AI assistant process change emails, or let clients do it themselves with change forms. As a payroll administrator you only approve, and the manual work disappears.

P22.stelling_en: Employees do not enter their own changes.
P22.oplossing_en: Let employees enter changes in the employee portal or app.

P23.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time processing the year-end transition.
P23.oplossing_en: The Year-end Wizard moves payrolls to the new year automatically, including updating data and setting up new calculations.

P24.stelling_en: I have no overview of the payroll status of all clients at a glance, segmented by any criterion I want.
P24.oplossing_en: Payroll Workflows show the processing status per client instantly. Flexible tags let you segment by team, location or client size, so you see right away where action is needed.

P25.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time processing variable pay components and hours (such as overtime).
P25.oplossing_en: Quick entry lets you enter variable pay components and hours efficiently, with the option to create several quick-entry types.

P26.stelling_en: I spend a lot of time on salary changes that affect multiple employees.
P26.oplossing_en: Bulk entry applies salary changes for many employees at once, by percentage or fixed amount. It saves time, avoids repetitive work and reduces errors because the new salaries are visible before the change is saved.

P27.stelling_en: The collective agreement models are standard and cannot be adjusted.
P27.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs you can deviate from standard collective agreement rules, such as the leave model. The system is updated regularly to comply with the latest laws and regulations.

P28.stelling_en: Working out and testing a complex payroll is only possible to a limited extent in my current environment.
P28.oplossing_en: The Nmbrs Sandbox gives you a separate environment to design, build and test alternative payroll setups.

H01.stelling_en: Managing all HR processes is a lot of work.
H01.oplossing_en: Automate HR processes with our HR Workflows, so you never forget a task and efficiency is maximised.

H02.stelling_en: We have no uniform, automated HR process.
H02.oplossing_en: The standard workflows in Nmbrs tackle this, promoting efficiency, consistency and an organised approach.

H03.stelling_en: Drawing up contracts quickly and without errors is difficult.
H03.oplossing_en: Use our Word add-in to generate documents such as error-free employment contracts at the push of a button.

H04.stelling_en: Printing, scanning and emailing signed documents is time-consuming.
H04.oplossing_en: Speed up processes with digital signing in Nmbrs, so documents are handled online straight away.

H05.stelling_en: I miss a central overview of all HR documents and cases.
H05.oplossing_en: Create a digital file with a complete overview of all employees, cases and documents in the HR dashboard.

H06.stelling_en: I can't steer on HR data directly, because creating tailored overviews takes a lot of time.
H06.oplossing_en: Use our AI assistant to run any report or overview by simply asking a question in the chat.

H07.stelling_en: Collecting all required documents from new employees is always quite a job.
H07.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs, HR Workflows collect documents from employees automatically, instead of you gathering them. Think of diplomas, certificates, certificates of conduct and driving licences.

H08.stelling_en: Changes and approvals for salary and job changes are cumbersome.
H08.oplossing_en: Simplify changes with the change forms module, which lets clients carry out and approve actions themselves. Salary changes can also start an HR workflow. Job changes are currently only possible through change forms.

H09.stelling_en: I don't receive automatic alerts about important HR tasks and milestones.
H09.oplossing_en: Receive automatic HR signals that notify everyone involved, including CEOs, HR and employees, so contract renewals and other HR tasks are not forgotten.

H10.stelling_en: Paying out expense claims is not well integrated with my payroll payments.
H10.oplossing_en: Let employees claim expenses easily in their Nmbrs environment (portal and app), with an integrated approval flow (change forms) and payout on the next payslip. Integrated in the payment run.

H11.stelling_en: Keeping track of leave requests and absence is difficult.
H11.oplossing_en: Give clients access to the Nmbrs leave and absence module (leave via portal and app), so they handle leave requests and track absence themselves.

H12.stelling_en: I have no direct insight into my team's absence rate.
H12.oplossing_en: Monitor absence rates easily with HR reports and dashboards that show all relevant information at a glance.

H13.stelling_en: Processing parental leave for an employee takes me a lot of time.
H13.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs, parental leave is processed on one payslip, so the correct income relationship goes straight to the tax authority. A separate feature tracks the balance, visible to the employee.

H14.stelling_en: I have no insight into employee engagement.
H14.oplossing_en: Nmbrs Engage makes employee engagement measurable and visible with short, anonymous pulse surveys that employees complete without logging in. You get direct insight into satisfaction, work experience and key themes such as trust, wellbeing, growth opportunities and job satisfaction.

H15.stelling_en: Tracking the progress of employees' goals is difficult.
H15.oplossing_en: Throughout the year, HR professionals have easy insight into the status of every employee. That creates moments to pause on the different goals and reflect on progress.

H16.stelling_en: I can't develop my employees on specific skills or qualities.
H16.oplossing_en: When creating a personal plan, employees choose the skills or qualities they want to develop. Pick from our 20 competencies or add your own. Nmbrs Perform handles the full performance cycle for individuals and teams.

H17.stelling_en: Having employees assessed by several people is complicated for us.
H17.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs Perform employees easily receive feedback from their peers. The tool helps ask for it effectively and positively by giving employees a clear format.

H18.stelling_en: I don't receive automatic signals about HR events.
H18.oplossing_en: Receive HR signals with automatic reminders for reviews and milestones. You can even create a signal for an agreed action point, such as the next review.

H19.stelling_en: Entering performance reviews manually is time-consuming.
H19.oplossing_en: Enter review data easily in structured fields such as date, type, rating and comments, and upload notes from a document.

H20.stelling_en: I miss a clear HR tool for developing my employees.
H20.oplossing_en: Use Nmbrs Perform for a complete overview of employee development at a glance.

H21.stelling_en: We lack an intuitive tool to automate HR processes.
H21.oplossing_en: Use the intuitive HR Workflows to automate processes easily.

H22.stelling_en: Generating and managing HR documents is complex.
H22.oplossing_en: Generate documents easily with the Word add-on and manage them in a structured way in the digital file.

H23.stelling_en: We have to use separate tools for leave registration and absence management.
H23.oplossing_en: Combine leave and absence management in one integrated Nmbrs module for a more efficient workflow. For example, all absence notifications are forwarded to the occupational health service automatically.

H24.stelling_en: The approval flow for expense claims is not integrated in my HR system.
H24.oplossing_en: Integrate the expense approval flow in Nmbrs for smooth, automated handling.

H25.stelling_en: I miss a structured approach to HR reports and dashboards.
H25.oplossing_en: Use integrated HR reports and dashboards for a structured, clear approach.

H26.stelling_en: I find the recruitment process rather chaotic, with all the emails, documents and so on.
H26.oplossing_en: Nmbrs Hire lets you post vacancies and manage applications, and new hires move into Nmbrs with one click.

H27.stelling_en: I forget to update vacancies on job sites. I have little time and attention for it.
H27.oplossing_en: In Nmbrs Hire you manage your own recruitment processes easily and connect them quickly to other popular platforms.

H28.stelling_en: Screening candidates is sometimes quite time-consuming.
H28.oplossing_en: To keep communication clear and fair, Nmbrs Hire screens all candidates and helps communicate with applicants through a set of selection questions.

H29.stelling_en: In job interviews we regularly don't have the right people at the table on our side, so we miss a qualitative assessment.
H29.oplossing_en: With Nmbrs Hire the right disciplines join the recruitment process at the right moments for a valuable assessment. One integrated process across the organisation.

H30.stelling_en: Our selection process is managed well and efficiently.
H30.oplossing_en: Nmbrs Hire gives a clear overview of every candidate's progress and lets you update their status easily.

T01.stelling_en: I am afraid people in my organisation will gain access to data they shouldn't see.
T01.oplossing_en: Use User Templates to give users access to Nmbrs at different levels. You define exactly which levels and dashlets a user may see and edit, and you can adjust the templates as you like.

T02.stelling_en: I am worried about the security of my data.
T02.oplossing_en: With ISAE 3402 type 2 certification and GDPR-compliant processing, your data is processed securely and in line with laws and regulations. Nmbrs also uses an SSL connection so information is sent securely and others cannot access it.

T03.stelling_en: I have no control over deleting outdated data under the GDPR.
T03.oplossing_en: Use the GDPR tool to delete data with a 2- or 5-year retention period on time. It shows when data can be deleted based on criteria and makes deleting it easy.

T04.oplossing_en: Log in easily with a username and password or choose one of several Single Sign-On methods. As extra security there is IP validation, and multi-factor authentication can be enabled.

T05.stelling_en: I'm not sure I use up-to-date software that keeps us secure and compliant with laws and regulations.
T05.oplossing_en: Updates take place every week. That lets us update Nmbrs quickly and regularly, controlled by our extensive change management procedures, to offer the best and safest platform possible.

T06.stelling_en: It is likely that hackers will gain access to online software.
T06.oplossing_en: That risk is indeed always there. We do everything to stay ahead of it and take the necessary security measures. Every year we run a penetration test in which an ethical hacker tries to break in. If they find anything, we fix it proactively.

T07.stelling_en: I am worried about the availability and continuity of my data or my clients' data.
T07.oplossing_en: To safeguard availability and continuity, Nmbrs makes several kinds of backups: every 5 to 10 minutes, daily, weekly, monthly and yearly.

T08.stelling_en: Logging in is cumbersome and takes several steps.
T08.oplossing_en: Set up two-factor authentication for extra security: users log in once and then enter a generated code.

T09.stelling_en: I have to remember different login details for different applications.
T09.oplossing_en: Use Single Sign-On (SSO) in Nmbrs, so you log in once to access several applications and websites.

T10.stelling_en: I can't easily log in with my existing Google account.
T10.oplossing_en: Use your Google account, Apple ID or Visma Connect to log in to Nmbrs effortlessly.

T11.oplossing_en: Nmbrs already integrates with many packages for accounting, planning, support, recruitment and accountancy. An integration exchanges data between Nmbrs and another system, via the API or a direct connection.

T12.stelling_en: I can't use the system in my preferred language.
T12.oplossing_en: Set the interface and documentation to Dutch, English, Swedish or German, depending on each user's preference.

T13.stelling_en: Managing clients is awkward and inflexible.
T13.oplossing_en: Use tags for flexible client management and add notes to clients, companies and employees for better internal communication.

T14.stelling_en: Finding certain functions in the system is sometimes a search.
T14.oplossing_en: Use the Co-pilot for easy navigation and notifications, so you never lose sight of a task.

T15.stelling_en: I miss important alerts and notifications in the system.
T15.oplossing_en: Receive smart notifications and push messages for open tasks and completed processes, so you always stay informed of important events.

Z01.stelling_en: I spend quite some time updating employee details, while employees should be able to do this themselves.
Z01.oplossing_en: In the Nmbrs app every employee can easily change their own details.

Z02.stelling_en: Employees have no easy access to their payslips.
Z02.oplossing_en: In the Nmbrs app every employee can view their payslips and annual statement, if the template allows it.

Z03.stelling_en: Leave cannot be requested through an app.
Z03.oplossing_en: In the Nmbrs app you can request and view leave.

Z04.stelling_en: Employees cannot view their documents, such as employment contracts or certificates, in one place.
Z04.oplossing_en: The app shows the documents the employer has uploaded. Signed documents are not shown in the app.

Z05.stelling_en: Birthdays of colleagues or team leads are often forgotten.
Z05.oplossing_en: Employees under the same client and in the same department can see each other's birthdays.

Z06.stelling_en: The employer has no overview of employees' holiday planning.
Z06.oplossing_en: Employees in the same company and department can see each other's leave.

Z07.stelling_en: Processing expense claims for my clients is a time-consuming process.
Z07.oplossing_en: In the Nmbrs app you submit an expense claim (costs, mileage) with a date, amount, description and an attachment (photo or file).

Z08.stelling_en: Splitting VAT on expense claims takes me a lot of time.
Z08.oplossing_en: Nmbrs Expense handles this: the employee supplies the data (photo and VAT check) and the accounting split is fully automated in the export to the bookkeeping.

Z09.stelling_en: Employees have to wait a long time to get their expenses reimbursed.
Z09.oplossing_en: Activating direct payout in the Nmbrs Expense module gets expenses back to employees faster, and the bookkeeping is updated without errors through an automatic Excel import.
